analysis_steps.goal: Fit spherical outflow model to H2O 3(3,0)-3(2,1) absorption and derive mass outflow rate

method.value: Spherical shell with constant mass outflow rate, Sobolev optical depth, convolved with Gaussian; mdot from fitted v0, tau0 with assumed water abundance

evidence.quote: a spherical continuum emitter is surrounded by a shell of outflowing gas which we assume to feature a constant mass outflow rate
we adopt the same abundance inferred for local ULIRGS ($\chi_{H_2O}\sim10^{-6}$)

evidence.quote: Because of this, we assume that the emission is negligible.

results_numeric.quantity: Beam-deconvolved FIR continuum size, northern image

evidence.quote: has a beam-deconvolved size of $(0.34\pm0.03)''\times(0.19\pm0.02)''$

results_numeric.quantity: Absorption blueshift of dip relative to CO centroid

evidence.quote: The bottom of the absorption feature is blueshifted by $\sim170$ km s$^{-1}$

findings_qualitative.value: Asymmetric blueshifted H2O absorption indicates a dense molecular outflow with velocities up to 500 km/s; merger interpretation disfavoured in favour of a single compact starburst core

evidence.quote: Finally, our results show that the previous interpretation of a major merger for the kinematics of this source is untenable.

claims.experiment: Band 7 observations of two high-excitation H2O lines
claims.result: Blueshifted asymmetric absorption seen in northern and southeastern images
claims.finding: A dense molecular outflow along the line of sight is present

evidence.loc: Results and evidence for molecular outflow
evidence.quote: can only be explained in terms of a dense molecular outflow along the line of sight

claims.hypothesis: The starburst exceeds the Eddington-limited SFR surface density
claims.experiment: Measure continuum size at 0.14'' resolution and combine with SED SFR

evidence.quote: a factor of five times higher than that of ‘maximum’ (i.e. Eddington-limited) starbursts

claims.finding: Outflow is massive but eta well below unity, so star formation runs away

evidence.quote: In this extreme galaxy the outflow, despite being very massive, is not vigorous enough to regulate star formation.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Major merger interpretation rejected; considered biconic outflow and water dip as systemic velocity

evidence.quote: our results show that the previous interpretation of a major merger for the kinematics of this source is untenable

limitations_admitted.value: Outflow loading factor poorly constrained; shell thickness unconstrained

evidence.quote: The outflow loading factor in SPT0346-52 is not well constrained

referee_caveats_inferred: Mdot depends strongly on assumed water abundance, shell width and excitation temperature
Fit to a single spectrum with simple spherical geometry
Outflow rate depends on choice of systemic redshift (drops >10x if absorption dip used)
Upper-limit size R_IN set by beam

data_public_as_stated.value: Calibrated cubes at CDS; model code on GitHub
